text.aria-label: Subtitle text '44 simulated plants at the real sites' positions, generated with a different decomposition, transposition, and a temperature derate from the fit's, with real weather-correlated noise. The dashed line is perfect recovery. The fit has no temperature input, so tilt absorbs part of the temperature effect.'

The dashed line is perfect recovery. The fit has no temperature input, so tilt absorbs part of the temperature
